summary_hint: carrier, named insured, insured property, dwelling (Coverage A) limit and its loss-settlement basis, annual premium, effective→expiration dates, and whether the lender is named as mortgagee — the headline a processor wants without opening the declarations page.

typed_core.name: named_insured
typed_core.why: PII; identity — whose policy; attach to borrower. Flatten from named_insureds/party_names.

typed_core.name: named_insured_2
typed_core.why: PII; identity — co-insured (joint policy).

typed_core.name: named_insured_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — verbatim insured line so a bad name split stays visible (bank_statement pattern).

typed_core.name: insurance_carrier
typed_core.why: identity — which carrier; issuer_name folds here.

typed_core.name: agency_producer_name
typed_core.why: processor — agency/producer for follow-up; flatten from agency_or_producer.

typed_core.name: policy_number
typed_core.why: PII (restricted); identity — cross-document key.

typed_core.name: policy_form
typed_core.why: disambiguator — HO-3 vs HO-6 unit-owner triggers IH-7; the ISO form code (e.g. HO 00 03) also disambiguates the loss-settlement basis for IH-1.
typed_core.prompt_hint: ISO homeowners form codes (HO 00 03/05/06/08) OR a carrier-specific homeowners form number on the declarations (e.g. 'HO5031'). NOT an Evidence-of-Insurance/document code (e.g. 'PH-EOI'); NOT a policy-TYPE word alone (e.g. 'Condominium'). NOTE: homeowners_insurance.txt is hand-maintained — documents intent.

typed_core.name: policy_status
typed_core.why: processor — active/in-force evidence.

typed_core.name: insured_property_address
typed_core.why: identity — links policy to the subject property; IH-1 compares to loan/property. PII.

typed_core.name: effective_date
typed_core.why: IH-3 — must be on/before closing.

typed_core.name: expiration_date
typed_core.why: processor — coverage must run through closing; recency.

typed_core.name: dwelling_coverage_a
typed_core.why: IH-1, IH-7 — coverage vs loan amount/replacement cost.
typed_core.prompt_hint: Coverage letters A–F map to Dwelling / Other Structures / Personal Property / Loss of Use / Personal Liability / Medical Payments — read Coverage A for the dwelling; do not read the personal-property (C) replacement-cost row for the dwelling basis.

typed_core.name: replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis
typed_core.why: IH-1 — the dwelling loss-settlement basis; this is the LP-431 field that was read but discarded to the catch-all, killing IH-1.

typed_core.name: wind_hail_hurricane_coverage
typed_core.why: IH-8 — wind/hail presence in applicable states. (IH-8 status BLOCKED.)

typed_core.name: wind_hail_deductible
typed_core.why: disambiguator — a distinct wind/hail/named-storm deductible is evidence wind coverage exists, disambiguating IH-8.

typed_core.name: annual_premium
typed_core.why: DT-5, IH-4 — premium used in payment vs binder.

typed_core.name: premium_paid_or_due_status
typed_core.why: processor — paid-in-full is in-force evidence.

typed_core.name: mortgagee_name
typed_core.why: IH-2 — the named mortgagee must match the lender.

typed_core.name: mortgagee_clause_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — verbatim clause for the DET+AI clause parse (ISAOA/ATIMA, loan #).
typed_core.prompt_hint: Mortgagee clause = lender's interest; expect ISAOA ATIMA and the lender loan number.

typed_core.name: mortgagee_count
typed_core.why: disambiguator — number of lienholder entries so a second lienholder is not silently dropped.

typed_core.name: document_issue_date
typed_core.why: processor — binder preparation date; document-age.

nested_lists.name: forms_and_endorsements
nested_lists.shape_reason: few items (typically 2–6 form/endorsement codes), so token cost is trivial and well under the 16,384 ceiling — flat rows suffice.

fields.name: code_or_label
fields.why: IH-1 — the HO 00 03-class form code that encodes replacement-cost settlement when no words appear (the Occidental case)

fields.name: description
fields.why: IH-8 — a separate wind/hail endorsement description

fields.name: premium_or_amount
fields.why: the endorsement premium/cost column, verbatim (may be INCL, a credit, or a dollar line) — LP-460

nested_lists.name: coverage_lines
nested_lists.shape_reason: the Coverage B-F schedule (A is the coverage_amount scalar) — each line's limit + premium. Deductibles are policy-level, not per-line on the document. Captured for future coverage-adequacy rules; no live consumer yet (LP-460).

fields.name: premium
fields.why: the coverage premium as written (may be 'INCL')

rejected.name: other_structures_coverage_b, personal_property_coverage_c, loss_of_use_coverage_d, personal_liability_coverage_e, medical_payments_coverage_f
rejected.reason: no rule reads them; a processor rarely needs them pre-submission — catch-all

rejected.name: deductibles (general)
rejected.reason: no rule reads the amount; wind/hail deductible kept as a flattened disambiguator, the rest to catch-all

rejected.name: issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: contact detail with no rule; catch-all

rejected.name: statement_period_start / _end
rejected.reason: insurance uses effective/expiration; these duplicate them

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: a policy is not a standardized single form; policy_form carries the ISO code

rejected.name: party_addresses
rejected.reason: insured address captured via insured_property_address; mailing address to catch-all

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: a binder/dec page is not executed/notarized

rejected.name: covered_perils (as a conclusion)
rejected.reason: tags describe; capture forms/endorsements verbatim, let the rule judge adequacy

encoding_variations: Loss-settlement basis stated three ways: explicit Dwelling Replacement Cost: Y flag (Universal — beware the adjacent Personal Property Replacement Cost: N), a bare ISO form code HO 00 03 (Occidental — no words), or prose 'replacement cost settlement applies'. Carry policy_form / forms_and_endorsements alongside replacement_cost_or_coinsurance_basis so the value is trustable.

Premium stated as annual vs monthly (a $140/mo binder = $1,680/yr); DT-5/IH-4 compare against the monthly figure used in the payment — annual_premium needs the annual/monthly label as its disambiguator.
Mortgagee clause with ISAOA/ATIMA suffixes and an embedded loan number — retain mortgagee_clause_raw for the AI parse.
Coverage A labelled 'Dwelling', 'Coverage A', or 'Section I-A' — same fact.

open_questions.q: forms_and_endorsements as a nested list vs flattened string.
options: defer the list and keep a single joined endorsements_raw string until IH-8 unblocks
open_questions.recommendation: (a) — the list is cheap (few items) and is the durable home for the disambiguator the standard was written around. GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

open_questions.q: wind_hail_hurricane_coverage degradation. It is an object in the catalog (limit + separate deductible + sub-limit). Flattened to a str presence/summary here.
options: keep the str summary plus the separate wind_hail_deductible
open_questions.recommendation: keep the str summary plus the separate wind_hail_deductible; revisit a coercer only if IH-8 needs a numeric limit.

open_questions.q: IH-7 lives on a different document. The master-policy adequacy check reads the condo master policy, not this HO-6 dec page. Here only policy_form (HO-6) triggers the requirement.
options: confirm IH-7's snapshot_path points at the master-policy schema
open_questions.recommendation: confirm IH-7's snapshot_path points at the master-policy schema, not this one.

open_questions.q: Mortgagee as flat vs nested. Kept flat (mortgagee_name + _raw + _count) on the assumption of 1–2 lienholders.
options: revisit as a list if a second-lien scenario needs each entry addressed individually
open_questions.recommendation: revisit as a list only if a second-lien scenario needs each entry addressed individually. GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

notes: 'Binder', 'Declarations Page', 'Evidence of Insurance' are the same document family.

PII section flags named_insured, named_insured_2, named_insured_raw (person names, pre_masked false), policy_number (restricted, pre_masked true), and insured_property_address (real address, pre_masked false) for _PII_FIELDS registration — none are in the 7-field registry today.

Ambiguity: insured_property_address is tagged identity (test 3) but also serves IH-1 (could read as reason_class rule); classified identity to match the borrower_name/identity precedent, with IH-1 carried in rules.

Ambiguity: person-name PII fields (named_insured*) are registered with an invented kind 'NAME' (pre_masked false) since the markdown explicitly lists them for _PII_FIELDS; the worked examples left names unregistered.
